column5: Every night is now pitch black.
The tides shrink to about one third.
Corals that spawn by the full moon lose their signal.
Without the Moon holding it steady, Earth's tilt could start to wobble.
The Moon is already leaving us.
In nineteen sixty-nine, astronauts left mirrors on it.
Scientists still fire lasers at them.
Every year, the Moon drifts about three point eight centimeters away.
Next time you see the Moon… look up.
It won't stay this close forever.
